key_insight: A decoder- and noise-aware search can efficiently find Clifford deformations that substantially improve quantum error-correcting codes without adding qubits or changing code distance.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical optimization workflow for tailoring surface-code variants to the actual circuit noise and decoder used in a fault-tolerant quantum computer.
method: Treat circuit, noise model, and decoder as a black box.
Use Evolution-Based Best-arm Identification (EBBI) to search the exponentially large Clifford-deformation space with few shots.
Benchmark on rotated surface codes under strongly Z-biased circuit-level noise with PyMatching.
evidence_signal: At distance 3, EBBI found the optimal deformation using up to about 1100× fewer shots than random search, and at distance 5 it converged to the authors’ believed-optimal codes while random search did not.
watch_item: The best deformation depends strongly on the specific noise model and decoder, so results may not transfer directly across hardware platforms or decoding pipelines.
paper_title: Decoder- and Noise-Aware Optimization Framework for Clifford-Deformed Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
